catalog_authority_13.reason: The authority set is dominated by internationally documented high mountains and is not representative of the 359-row catalog.

summit_world_peak_7.required_disclaimer: 样本为 7 座世界级高峰，不代表目录整体，尤其不代表低海拔小山。
summit_world_peak_7.reporting_rule: The disclaimer must appear beside every mention of a result or count from these seven cases. Never publish a standalone 7/7-style claim.

mechanical_sanity_gates.effective_entry_rule: No boolean callbacks. Rerun pinned source adapters from response bytes and recompute gate values. Phase 0 has no pinned Copernicus GeoTIFF adapter, so resolved/effective output must fail closed until Phase 1 implements that derivation.

seed_displacement.rule: A larger displacement cannot be resolved automatically; it remains review-required.

coordinate_precision.method: derive the minimum decimal count from latitude_literal and longitude_literal, parse both literals back to the numeric coordinates, and reject any supplied precision mismatch

dataset.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
dataset.access: Copernicus Data Space S3-compatible object storage or OData; registered account and temporary credentials required
dataset.license: COP-DEM GLO-30 Full, Free & Open with required attribution

dem_local_maximum.radius_basis: A 300m geodesic radius spans roughly ten 30m samples from the candidate in each direction, large enough to reject article or scenic-area centers while remaining a local summit test.
pass_contract: Load the source tile bytes from the hash-bound DEM CAS, never from labels in a result row.
Compute every DEM sample whose cell center lies within the 300m geodesic disk.
Locate the maximum elevation mechanically from those samples.
Pass only when the candidate is within 45m of a maximum cell and no more than 8m below that maximum.
Run the separate ledger-altitude tolerance gate as well; DEM local maximum does not replace elevation sanity.
known_limits: GLO-30 is a DSM, so vegetation and structures can influence low-elevation maxima.
The 30m grid cannot establish sub-cell summit position; the 45m alignment allowance reflects grid sampling, not a looser coordinate truth standard.
A failed DEM gate yields needs_review or unresolved; it is never silently overridden to improve coverage.

stratified_manual_audit.population: all 359 effective canonical rows before any source result is known

low_altitude_small_mountain.definition: effective altitude is non-null and below 1000m

stratified_manual_audit.selection_algorithm: Before provider collection, calculate proportional marginal targets for each category in difficulty, altitude_band, and province. Iteratively select the row that reduces the largest combined marginal deficit; break ties by SHA-256(seed + ':' + effective_canonical_key). Freeze the selected JSONL and SHA before requests begin.
anti_cherry_pick: Do not substitute a famous or easy-to-find mountain.
Do not replace blocked, missing, needs_review, or unresolved selections.
Report selection and pipeline failure as evidence, not as grounds for resampling.
evidence_packet: source votes with lineage and datum
Copernicus DEM local window summary and profile or contour evidence
surrounding terrain or satellite basemap reference
all sanity gate inputs, computations, and verdicts
stratified_manual_audit.accuracy_source: Only the human-adjudicated stratified sample may support catalog-wide accuracy conclusions.

catalog_accuracy_13.description: Historical membership label retained for gold-set compatibility; these 13 authority cases are now connectivity smoke only and not an accuracy denominator.

summit_accuracy_independent_summit_7.description: Historical membership label retained for gold-set compatibility; these seven world-class peaks are connectivity smoke only and not representative of catalog accuracy.
summit_accuracy_independent_summit_7.required_disclaimer: 样本为 7 座世界级高峰，不代表目录整体，尤其不代表低海拔小山。

legacy_regression_18.description: Production coordinates are historical state, not assumed summit truth. Report proposed displacement and compatibility impact only.

evidence_definitions.verified_attempt_count_proxy: checkins with verified_at; checkin-level distance evidence is counted separately
evidence_definitions.terminal_outcome_ratio_pct: trek_sessions status=summit_verified divided by statuses in summit_verified|finished|aborted; this is not an attempt pass rate
known_limitations: The database does not preserve every failed verification attempt as a row.
A zero verification_distance_m is non-diagnostic and cannot independently establish coordinate accuracy.
Historical-photo and track-import verification are not equivalent to independent real-device summit GPS evidence.
evidence_definitions.observation_window: all matching rows through the 2026-07-26 read-only snapshot
source_filters: verified_at is not null for verified checkin aggregates
evidence_definitions.fixture_exclusion_status: not proven; therefore the snapshot cannot promote a legacy row

legacy_promotion_policy.decision: No legacy row currently satisfies every criterion. High-volume rows contain non-diagnostic zero distances or outliers; rows with clean-looking success rates have grid signals, semantic ambiguity, or no checkin-level distance evidence.

semantic_difference_exclusions.rule: Do not cite the roughly 31.4 km 武夷山 to huanggang-shan delta as coordinate inaccuracy.
semantic_difference_exclusions.reason: The legacy 武夷山 semantic scope is not equivalent to the huanggang-shan alias-merge target; the displacement is semantic and target identity remains review-sensitive.
